claim.purpose: Finalize and independently review the Agent Logic repository migration runbook

initial.title: [v0.92][WP-01A][github] Finalize Agent Logic repository migration plan
initial.goal: Produce the final executable Agent Logic repository migration plan from current live inventory truth.
initial.required_outcome: A concise reviewed runbook names the five transfers, exclusions, website cutover, exact verification, rollback, and residual risks without performing migration work.
authority_boundary: Issue 5815 owns the migration plan only
No repository transfer or organization mutation is authorized
Gemini review is advisory and cannot authorize execution
operator_constraints: Use current live GitHub inventory as evidence
Keep the plan concise and executable
Do not transfer repositories or inspect secret values
Use Gemini 3.1 Pro for the bounded final review
initial.task_boundary: Finalize and review one repository migration runbook.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly five repositories are marked migrate
asksifu is retained personally and Horust is excluded
The website production and beta link updates are explicit
Each transfer has preflight, verification, stop, and rollback gates
Gemini findings are incorporated or dispositioned
dependencies: Current GitHub source and destination inventories
non_goals: Remote, website, Actions, package, DNS, secret, or permission mutation
initial.plan_summary: Reconcile the draft to live inventory, simplify it into an operator-ready runbook, review it with Gemini 3.1 Pro, incorporate findings, and publish the documentation change.

steps.action: Reconcile repository and website inventory into the final runbook
Run focused document validation and Gemini 3.1 Pro review
Incorporate actionable findings and seal the final reviewed plan

invariants: No tracked edit occurs on main
No secret value is inspected or recorded
asksifu and Horust are never transfer candidates
risks: GitHub transfer behavior may differ for forks, packages, Pages, Actions, or private networks
Website links may temporarily point to a nonexistent destination if cutover is not coordinated
Historical owner references must not be rewritten as if they were current dependencies
stop_conditions: Any request to transfer a repository or mutate GitHub organization state
Any need to inspect secret values
Any edit outside declared or issue-local paths

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate inventory wording, link references, Markdown hygiene, and diff scope

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed if inventory is ambiguous, scope widens, or the plan implies transfer authorization.
review_prompts: Does the runbook reflect current GitHub inventory and exclusions?
Are transfer-specific GitHub risks and verification gates complete?
Is the agent-logic.ai cutover coordinated without relying on redirects?
Can the runbook be simplified without weakening safety?
initial.review_scope: Only the final migration plan and issue-local evidence.
